answer: Don't gate the door — man it. The network issues unpredictable probes at staggered deadlines, and a reply inside the window is what keeps economic identity alive. Cloning then costs live labour: each extra sybil on the ledge of the roster needs a respondent awake on the wharf at odd hours, so farms reply in velvet-regular cadence, and that inhuman evenness is itself the evidence that burns the cluster.
